tasks.spec:
You are the senior decision-maker on a text-message appointment-recall workflow for an optometry practice. You are NOT implementing anything. Your entire output is one JSON file recording the consequential decisions that an implementation model must not be allowed to make on its own. A separate builder model will implement against your decisions afterwards.

BOUNDARY, read before anything else. Everything you need is staged in ./sources/ inside your current task directory. NEVER read, write, or modify anything outside your current task directory. NEVER run git. NEVER commit. NEVER call a network endpoint or external API. NEVER load skills, call MCP tools or Apps, or capture notes to any external memory or knowledge base. The ONLY file you create is ./decisions.json in your current task directory.

BACKGROUND. A Bland SMS pathway (version 20) sends appointment-recall texts. A sender program resolves a patient by ID and starts a conversation, passing recall_patient_id and recall_cell. The pathway runs silent webhook nodes against a booking gateway, offers up to two openings, and books one through a governed /sign route. It has fourteen confirmed defects plus sixteen additional findings. It is being rebuilt as version 21 around three lanes: (1) patient picks an offered time, we verify the schedule and book it; (2) patient wants something else, so a standalone availability-negotiation loop must be reachable from ANY point in the conversation; (3) patient wants something we do not handle, so we direct them to the office.

STAGED SOURCES:
- verified-defects.md — the resolved defect ledger. READ THIS FIRST. It records where two independent analysis passes disagreed and how each disagreement was resolved. Defect ids are F1 through F14 and AD3 through AD16.
- v21-plan.md — the approved target architecture and the human owner's decisions already taken. Treat the human owner's explicit decisions as binding, not advisory.
- v20_sanitized.json — the current graph: a JSON object with nodes and edges arrays. Node data carries name, prompt, url, body, headers, responseData, responsePathways, extractVars, tools, modelOptions, isStart and userWait.
- mott-eyecloud-endpoint-field-catalog.csv — the booking gateway contract, including which endpoints are ready, blocked, or missing.
- mott-aws-response-data-inventory.md — approved response mappings per endpoint.
- v20-patient-id-two-slot-product-contract.md — the product and safety contract version 20 was built against.
- scout-report.md — the raw adversarial review. Its F9 and F14 verdicts were shown to be wrong; verified-defects.md holds the corrected resolution. Prefer the ledger over this file where they conflict.

YOUR JOB. Decide, and record, the things that must not be left to an implementation model: which defects are fixed in this build versus deferred, the global-node contract, the exact patient-facing opener template, what the model may and may not do with dates, the invariants that keep booking safe, what outcome data is captured, and what happens when the sender supplies no patient id.

WRITE ./decisions.json AS A SINGLE JSON OBJECT WITH EXACTLY THESE KEYS:

  schema_version    string, exactly "mott-v21-decisions.v1"
  in_scope          array of defect id strings fixed in this build
  deferred          array of objects {id, why} for defects NOT fixed in this build; every id F1..F14 must appear exactly once across in_scope and deferred; why must be at least 40 characters
  globals           array of objects {node, autoReturn, trigger, why}. autoReturn is a boolean. You must cover six roles: the negotiation loop, the office handoff, STOP, NOT ME, existing-appointment, and the 72-hour timeout. Think carefully about autoReturn: a global that auto-returns to the previous node cannot own a loop that must take over the conversation.
  opener            object {template, slot_render_rule, one_slot_rule}. template is the actual patient-facing message and MUST interpolate patient_first, slot_1_start, slot_1_end, slot_2_start and slot_2_end. slot_render_rule must name the display timezone explicitly. one_slot_rule says what the message does when only one opening exists.
  date_contract     object {passthrough_allowed, model_may_send, model_must_not, why}. The gateway owns a deterministic relative-date resolver, so passthrough_allowed must be true and model_must_not must explicitly forbid the model normalizing or computing calendar dates.
  booking_invariants array of at least three strings. Must state that booking goes through /sign only, that a conflict check precedes booking, and that confirmation is gated on book_success.
  analysis_schema   object with a fields array; each field is {name, type} plus values for enums. Must include an outcome field. MUST STAY FREE OF PATIENT-IDENTIFYING DATA: no patient id, name, date of birth, phone, mobile, cell, email, address or insurance in any field name or enum value.
  start_guard       object {on_missing_patient_id, why}
  additional_findings array of objects {id, decision, why} where decision is "in_scope" or "deferred". You must decide at least AD5, AD9, AD11, AD12, AD13 and AD15 explicitly.
  owned_paths       exactly ["scripts/build_v21_recall_lanes.py", "scripts/validate_v21.py", "tests/test_v21_scenarios.py"]
  verification_commands array of executable commands that prove the build. They must not grant network, install, deploy or source-control authority, and none may be a command that cannot fail.
  hardest_decision  string, at least 40 characters
  alternatives_rejected array of at least two strings
  least_confident_assumption string, at least 40 characters

HARD RULES. Do not invent gateway endpoints or capabilities; the catalog states which are ready, blocked or missing, and a blocked or missing endpoint cannot be part of an in-scope fix. Do not put patient-identifying data in the analysis schema. Do not weaken any booking safety invariant to simplify the graph. Where the human owner has already decided something in v21-plan.md, record their decision rather than overriding it. Where you are genuinely uncertain, say so in least_confident_assumption instead of inventing confidence. Output valid JSON only in ./decisions.json, with no surrounding prose or code fences.
tasks.verified: the decision packet classifies every defect, declares a six-role global-node contract with explicit autoReturn, carries an opener template that actually interpolates the slot variables, forbids model-side date computation, keeps booking invariants intact, and holds a PHI-free outcome schema
